blocks.label: Short answer
blocks.copy: Mac dictation is private only if the specific workflow keeps recognition local, avoids storing sensitive audio or transcripts, explains permissions, and makes optional cloud features obvious. Do not rely on a one-word privacy claim. Follow the audio and text from microphone to final app.
points: Check processing location and the app's full data path.
Check what the receiving app does with inserted text.

content.s: Gojo's dictation feature uses a downloaded local model and inserts text into the active field. It does not require an API key or cloud transcription service for recognition.
